note: Curated list of official / established UK free advice services. Eligibility for any support varies with individual circumstances. Last reviewed by the team: November 2026.

resources.name: MoneyHelper
resources.what: Free, impartial money and debt guidance backed by the UK government.

resources.name: Citizens Advice
resources.what: Free, confidential advice on money, housing, work and bills.

resources.name: StepChange Debt Charity
resources.what: Free debt advice from a UK charity.

resources.name: UKCISA (UK Council for International Student Affairs)
resources.what: Information for international students, including money and work rules. Check what applies to your visa before applying for any public support.

resources.name: Your university's student support / money advice team
resources.what: Most UK universities have a student money adviser and some run hardship funds. Search your own university's website — Bridge does not list a specific scheme because availability and eligibility differ.
